message.entry: The add_bus option baseMVA is deprecated and ignored: the system base is net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA ({0} MVA).

The add_bus option baseMVA is deprecated and ignored: the given {0} MVA differs from the system base net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA = {1} MVA, which is used. Set net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA instead.
The initialize option methods is deprecated: use net.initialize(Method="{0}").
The initialize method "{0}" is deprecated: use net.initialize(Method="{1}"). Note that initialize now returns [result, flag, output]; result.tab_bus is the old second output.

Continuation_Power_Flow(net, opt) is deprecated: use [result, flag] = net.calculate_continuation_powerflow(LoadBus=opt.CPFBus). The v3 options map to LoadBus, InitialLambda, MaxIteration, StepSize, ArcLength and UseInternalState; result.rm_x is the old CPF_Result.x_sol.

CsvNetHandler.import(path, net) is deprecated: use net = PowerNetwork.import_csv(path) for a new network, or PowerNetwork.import_csv(path, Network=obj) to load into an existing one (e.g. in the constructor of a network class).
CsvNetHandler.export(net, ModelName, savepath=folder) is deprecated: use net.export_csv(fullfile(folder, "@"+ModelName)). The folder now also holds network/parameter.csv with Hz and baseMVA.
The option Algorithm of net.linearize and net.get_sys is renamed: use Method="{0}".

The option NonUnit of net.linearize and net.get_sys is deprecated: buses without states are handled automatically, so remove the option. A listed bus without states is ignored; a listed bus with states stops "Feedback" with an error.

net.solver_LIN.NonUnit is deprecated: buses without states are handled automatically, so remove the setting. A listed bus without states is ignored; a listed bus with states stops "Feedback" with an error.
